This article is a stub. Harper Time & Electronics was the American company credited with making
the first [Accusplit](accusplit.md) digital stopwatches, advertised to swimmers as the Harper
Accusplit I from 1973.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
